# moneybin db

Database management and exploration

Generated from the registered command tree, so every option below is one the command declares; `--help` on any command prints the same text. Shared flags, exit codes, and JSON envelopes: [CLI reference](../../guides/cli-reference.md).

Usage: `moneybin db [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...`

**Commands**

| Command | Purpose |
|---|---|
| [`moneybin db init`](#moneybin-db-init) | Create a new encrypted database with all schemas initialized. |

| [`moneybin db unlock`](#moneybin-db-unlock) | Derive key from passphrase and cache in OS keychain. |
| [`moneybin db ps`](#moneybin-db-ps) | Show processes holding the MoneyBin database file open. |

## moneybin db init

Create a new encrypted database with all schemas initialized.

By default, generates a random 256-bit encryption key and stores it
in the OS keychain (auto-key mode). Use --passphrase for passphrase-
based key derivation via Argon2id.

Usage: `moneybin db init [OPTIONS]`

**Options**

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--database, -d` | path |  | Path to DuckDB database file (default: profile config) |
| `--passphrase` | flag |  | Use passphrase-based key derivation instead of auto-generated key |
| `--yes, -y` | flag |  | Skip confirmation prompts |

## moneybin db shell

Open an interactive DuckDB SQL shell with encrypted database attached.

WARNING: Direct DB access — no privacy middleware applies.
Account numbers and sensitive fields are NOT masked here.
For agent-mediated access with privacy enforcement, use:
moneybin sql query "\<your SQL>"

Usage: `moneybin db shell [OPTIONS]`

**Options**

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--database, -d` | path |  | Path to DuckDB database file (default: profile config) |

## moneybin db query

Execute a SQL query against the encrypted DuckDB database.

WARNING: Direct DB access — no privacy middleware applies.
Account numbers and sensitive fields are NOT masked here.
For agent-mediated access with privacy enforcement, use:
moneybin sql query "\<your SQL>"

Usage: `moneybin db query [OPTIONS] SQL`

**Arguments**

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `SQL` | text | yes | SQL query to execute |

**Options**

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--database, -d` | path |  | Path to DuckDB database file (default: profile config) |
| `-o, --output` | one of `text`, `json`, `csv`, `markdown`, `box` | `text` | Output format: text, json, csv, markdown, or box |
| `-q, --quiet` | flag |  | Suppress informational output |

## moneybin db restore

Restore database from a backup file.

Usage: `moneybin db restore [OPTIONS]`

**Options**

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--from` | path |  | Path to backup file to restore from |
| `--yes, -y` | flag |  | Skip confirmation prompt |
| `--latest` | flag |  | Auto-select the most recent backup (non-interactive) |
